open_points.unit: 30_modules.md:Facts several modules touch, and their one owner
open_points.subject: PortRef reference variants
open_points.text: The functions capability keeps the broad PortRef input contract.
open_points.question: Which module owns the PortRef type and the definitions and discriminants of FileFactsRef, StoredValuesRef and SpooledFilesRef, which are used across runs and functions but are not among the M01–M28 models owned by models?
options: models owns the shared reference union and its variants
functions owns a capture-specific reference union
each caller defines its own reference representation
open_points.default_guess: models owns one shared PortRef union and its three variants

open_points.unit: 30_modules.md:Facts several modules touch, and their one owner
open_points.subject: capture input-reference resolution
open_points.text: runs passes to functions.add_captured_trial_case the executed implementation and the inputs of the record it captures, spooled files as their SpooledFiles ... functions ... refuses any FileFactsRef ... before looking up any input value or spooled file
open_points.question: Does runs resolve spooled-file facts into SpooledFile records before calling functions, or must functions receive every raw PortRef, scan the complete tuple first, and resolve readable references only after the FileFactsRef check?
options: functions receives raw PortRefs and performs all readable-reference lookup after the complete-tuple scan
runs resolves SpooledFiles before the call and functions scans the resulting tuple
NodeExecution already embeds complete SpooledFile records, so no lookup is needed before the call
open_points.default_guess: functions receives raw PortRefs, scans the complete tuple, and only then resolves StoredValuesRef and SpooledFilesRef through store
